jobs.description: Our mission  Bounti is building the AI-native infrastructure layer for frontline teams, spanning training, audits, and autonomous operations. We partner with multi-location operators in frontline industries such as hospitality. Behind the product sits a backend that has grown quickly: a Node and Postgres API, background workers, queues, and the AI pipelines powering our product. We're hiring a  Senior Backend Engineer  to own that layer as we scale it.
